_: Terrestria's volcanic rock wears as stone. Up to 1.21.1 the same rock is called basalt, which the rules read as rock and no file names; from 26.1 it is volcanic rock, which they do not. The rest of the mod is detection's: andisol and its podzol wear as dirt and its grass block as grass by their sounds, volcanic sand as sand by its class, and its path and farmland are refused by their words.

A slab or stair takes its full block's ruling (Xep, 2026-11-13: Can we make it so all slabs of blocks that wear, also wear, in their own like the full blocks do? and: Same with stairs as slabs; W4 R15). These are this mod's slabs and stairs whose full blocks a census of 26.2 judged, each named at its full block's family so it wears on its own texture as the full block does. A slab or stair of a block the census excluded, or never judged, is left as it was.
